prompt:
Output a standalone 4:5 vertical commercial poster, no collage, no multi-grid. Use an original fictional brand, do not imitate existing brand packaging, logos, or ads. Text must only use the brand name, main title, and category explicitly listed in the prompt; do not invent prices, awards, specs, dates, origins, or slogans. The image should reach creative direction review quality: realistic structure, credible materials, clear typography, no watermarks.

Theme: Headphone review sample. Original brand "SONA", product "ARC H1", main title "LISTEN".

Place a pair of graphite black over-ear headphones in a creamy white studio. Ear cups facing camera, headband slightly tilted back, real cushioning and metal hinges clearly visible. A matte cobalt blue solid sound wave ribbon, varying in width from narrow to wide, enters from bottom-left, passing sequentially through the left ear cup, space behind the headband, and right background, creating a gentle undulation. It is not glowing audio waves nor decorative curves, but flexible material with thickness, edges, and shadows.

Composition Core: "Product suspended on solid sound ribbon — Title forms sound chamber." Huge condensed font "LISTEN" arranged in depth behind the scene as six character frames. Headphones and sound ribbon weave alternately in front of and behind these frames, creating clear occlusion and spatial layers. Brand "SONA" at top, bottom text only "ARC H1 / HEADPHONES". Colors: Black, Warm White, Cobalt Blue. Direct soft lighting, still-life ad quality.

No people, stage lights, music festivals, EQ UI, spectrograms, red idol covers, neon, extra headphones, or meaningless tags.

promptZh:
输出一个独立的 4:5 竖版商业海报，无拼贴，无多格布局。使用原创虚构品牌，不得模仿现有品牌的包装、Logo 或广告。文本仅可使用提示词中明确列出的品牌名、主标题和类别；不得编造价格、奖项、规格、日期、产地或标语。图像需达到创意总监审核标准：结构真实、材质可信、排版清晰、无水印。

主题：耳机评测样片。原创品牌 "SONA"，产品 "ARC H1"，主标题 "LISTEN"。

在奶油白摄影棚中放置一副石墨黑头戴式耳机。耳罩面向镜头，头梁略微后倾，真实的缓冲垫和金属铰链清晰可见。一条哑光钴蓝色实体声波带从左下角进入，宽度由窄变宽，依次穿过左耳罩、头梁后方空间及右侧背景，形成柔和起伏。它不是发光音频波形或装饰曲线，而是具有厚度、边缘和阴影的柔性材质。

构图核心：“产品悬浮于实体声波带上——标题构成声腔。”巨大的压缩字体 "LISTEN" 以六个字符框架的形式排列在场景深处作为背景。耳机和声波带在这些框架前后交替穿插，形成清晰的遮挡关系和空间层次。顶部为品牌 "SONA"，底部文字仅为 "ARC H1 / HEADPHONES"。配色：黑色、暖白色、钴蓝色。直接柔光照明，静物广告品质。

禁止出现人物、舞台灯光、音乐节、EQ UI、频谱图、红色偶像封面、霓虹灯、多余耳机或无意义标签。
